description: Avoid inline shell escaping failures by writing script files first. Use when running multi-line Python/bash, heredocs, nested quotes, YAML/JSON in shell, audit logic, or after heredoc/syntax errors. Creates temp scripts (/tmp) or permanent scripts (scripts/). Invoke with /script-not-shell. Reduces retry loops and token waste.
